units.source_text: 我终于获得解脱，是在初夏时节，八重樱凋谢的枝头已不知何时萌生出了嫩叶。

en.t: I was finally released in early summer, when tender leaves had somehow begun to sprout on the branches where the double cherry blossoms had fallen.

units.source_text: 我怀着小鸟出笼般的心情，展望广阔的天地，自由地振翅飞翔。

en.t: With the feeling of a little bird let out of its cage, I looked out over the wide world and freely spread my wings.

units.source_text: 我马上去了先生家，

en.t: I went straight to Sensei's house,

units.source_text: 枳壳篱笆黑乎乎的枝条上发出了鲜绿的芽，

en.t: and fresh green buds had come out on the dark branches of the trifoliate orange hedge,

units.source_text: 石榴树的枯枝上，新长出的油亮而柔软的茶褐色叶子映着阳光。

en.t: while on the withered branches of the pomegranate tree, newly grown glossy, soft, tea brown leaves reflected the sunlight.

units.source_text: 一路上这些美景吸引着我的目光，仿佛有生以来头一次见到它们似的，只觉得新奇无比。

en.t: All along the way, these beautiful sights drew my eyes, and I found them wonderfully fresh, as if I were seeing them for the first time in my life.

units.source_text: 先生望着我欣喜的神色，说：“论文已经完成啦？不错嘛。”

en.t: Seeing the delighted look on my face, Sensei said, "So your thesis is finished? Good for you."

units.source_text: 我说：“多亏了您，总算完成了，现在没什么事了。”

en.t: I said, "Thanks to you, I finally finished it. Now I have nothing left to do."

units.source_text: 当时我的心情真是轻松极了，仿佛一切该做的事情都已了结，

en.t: At that time I felt truly lighthearted, as though everything I had to do had been settled,

units.source_text: 心情畅快，今后可以想怎么玩就怎么玩了。

en.t: and I was in such high spirits that from then on I felt I could play however I liked.

units.source_text: 我对自己完成的论文充满了信心，也十分满意，

en.t: I was full of confidence in the thesis I had completed, and I was thoroughly satisfied with it,

units.source_text: 在先生面前喋喋不休地讲着论文的内容，

en.t: so I talked on and on before Sensei about its contents,

units.source_text: 而先生依然像平时那样回应着“有道理”“是吗”，却没有予以任何评论。

en.t: but Sensei only responded in his usual way, saying "I see" and "Is that so," without offering any comment at all.

units.source_text: 我有些不满足，但更多的是扫兴。

en.t: I felt somewhat unsatisfied, but more than that, I felt let down.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，那天我精神充沛到足以挑战一下先生那看似因循的态度，

en.t: Even so, that day I had enough energy to challenge Sensei's seemingly passive attitude,

units.source_text: 我想邀请先生到正在复苏的大自然中去踏踏青：

en.t: and I wanted to invite him out into the reviving natural world for a spring walk:

units.source_text: “先生，到什么地方散散步吧。

en.t: "Sensei, let's go somewhere for a walk.

units.source_text: 一到外面，心情就会特别开朗。”

en.t: Once you get outside, it really brightens your mood."

units.source_text: “去哪儿？”

en.t: "Where to?"

units.source_text: 我去哪儿都可以，只想陪着先生去郊外走走。

en.t: Anywhere was fine with me; I only wanted to go out to the suburbs with Sensei.
